presentation: [Waves of the Earth] Queen Diane's damage dealt increases the more orbs she has in her Ultimate Move Gauge. At 4 or more orbs, she can remove 1 orb from the enemy.

passif.description:
When taking damage from an enemy attack, the hero's [00D5FF]damage dealt[-] increases by [FFAE00]15%[-] up to a maximum of [FFAE00]60%[-], and their Attack-related stats increase by [FFAE00]7%[-] up to a maximum of [FFAE00]28%[-].

The amount of HP they lose through skills and skill effects is converted to points that can accumulate up to a maximum of [FFAE00]500,000[-] points. When the hero uses a skill, their [00D5FF]damage dealt[-] increases by [FFAE00]30%[-] of their accumulated points.

Every time the hero enters a Stance, allies' Attack-related stats increase by [FFAE00]20%[-] for [FFAE00]2 turns[-]. While the Stance is active, allies' [00D5FF]damage taken[-] decreases by [FFAE00]40%[-].

While the hero is assuming a Stance, [00D5FF]Applicable Allies'[-] damage taken from skills during the enemy's turn does not exceed [FFAE00]50%[-] of Max HP. When the hero's Stance is removed, it restores [00D5FF]Applicable Allies'[-] HP by [FFAE00]20%[-] of Max HP.
[i][C0C0C0]※Applicable Allies: Giants and [The Seven Deadly Sins][-][/i]

The hero's [00D5FF]damage taken[-] decreases by [FFAE00]1%[-] for every [FFAE00]1%[-] of remaining HP.
